# Optimisation opportunities - review, not automation
Start with ownership and evidence gaps. Heuristics: CPU max >=90% highlights spikes; committed-memory max >=85%, available-memory min <512 MB, or disk-free min <15% asks for pressure review. Low CPU P95 <20% AND max <50% is a conversation candidate only when fresh, >=24h history and >=80% coverage; it is not a resize/shutdown recommendation. Missing memory/disk cannot establish safe headroom. There is no shutdown, delete, pricing, schedule or remediation action here.

Ownership is read live from exact Arc IDs via Resource Graph; blank tags are missing ownership evidence, not proof nobody owns a host. Telemetry and ARG timestamps can differ. Keep parent/guest observations separate; never add their hardware capacities or scenario values. No migration assessment, DR or SQL engine sizing is performed. No billed or realised savings claims.
